Name: Real Clock
Author: thimadera
Description:
[center][size=5][color=#FFD700][b]🕒 Real Clock for Stardew Valley 🌱[/b][/color][/size][/center]

The [i]Real Clock[/i] mod for [i]Stardew Valley[/i] offers a dynamic way to experience time in the game, giving you more control and realism over how time passes. 🌟 Inspired by the need for a more frequent and customizable time progression, this mod aims to enhance your gameplay experience.

[b][size=4][color=#00FF00]Key Features:[/color][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][color=#FFA500][b]Minute-by-Minute Clock Update[/b][/color]: Unlike the standard game mechanics where time updates every 10 in-game minutes, the [i]Real Clock[/i] mod updates the clock every minute, adding a new layer of immersion and detail to your [i]Stardew Valley[/i] journey. ⏰
[*][color=#FFA500][b]Customizable Time Speed[/b][/color]: By default, the mod retains the game's time speed (1 minute in-game equals 0.7 seconds real-time), but you have the power to adjust this to your preference. 🚀 Whether you want a faster-paced day or a leisurely stroll through Pelican Town, you can tailor the time speed to suit your playstyle.
[*][color=#FFA500][b]Flexible Time Format[/b][/color]: Choose between a 24-hour format or the traditional 12-hour format for displaying the in-game clock. 🕒 Enjoy the convenience of selecting your preferred time display to match your language and personal preference.
[/list]
[b][size=4][color=#00FF00]Configuration Options:[/color][/size][/b]
The [i]Real Clock[/i] mod offers versatile configuration options to tailor your [i]Stardew Valley[/i] experience:

[list]
[*] [b][color=#00BFFF]Enabled:[/color][/b] Toggle the mod on or off at your convenience. When disabled, time will revert to the default game settings.
[*] [b][color=#00BFFF]SecondsToMinutes:[/color][/b] Adjust the speed at which time progresses in-game. By default, time moves at 1 minute per 0.7 seconds. Modify this setting to speed up or slow down gameplay time to your preference.
[*] [b][color=#00BFFF]Show24Hours:[/color][/b] Choose between a 24-hour or 12-hour clock format. Opt for the 24-hour format for a precise display of time, or switch to the 12-hour format for a more familiar AM/PM timekeeping style.
[/list]
The [i]Real Clock[/i] mod seamlessly integrates with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][color=#00BFFF]Generic Mod Config Menu[/color][/url] for easy in-game configuration. Alternatively, you can manually adjust these settings by editing the [i]config.json[/i] file located in the mods folder.

Feel free to customize these options to suit your playstyle and immerse yourself in [i]Stardew Valley[/i] like never before!

[b][size=4][color=#00FF00]Installation:[/color][/size][/b]
To install [i]Real Clock[/i], download the mod files and unzip them in the appropriate mod folder. The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][color=#00BFFF]Generic Mod Config Menu[/color][/url] is recommended for streamlined configuration within the game.

[b][size=4][color=#00FF00]Inspiration & Credits:[/color][/size][/b]
The development of the [i]Real Clock[/i] mod was inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/624416][color=#00BFFF]adverserath[/color][/url]'s "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6011][color=#00BFFF]Casual Life[/color][/url]" mod. Initially, the mod incorporated elements from the "Casual Life" codebase, which was updated to accommodate [i]Stardew Valley[/i]'s 1.6 version. However, starting from version 1.2.0 of [i]Real Clock[/i], the code underwent a complete rewrite from scratch. This rewrite ensured that the mod is now entirely independent and no longer reliant on the original "Casual Life" code.

Special thanks to [url=https://www.kdau.com/][color=#00BFFF]kdau[/color][/url] for creating this very useful [url=https://www.kdau.com/scrollish][color=#00BFFF]web app[/color][/url].

[b][size=4][color=#00FF00]Source Code:[/color][/size][/b]
The source code for the Real Clock mod is available on [url=https://github.com/thimadera/StardewMods/tree/master/RealClock][color=#00BFFF]GitHub[/color][/url] for transparency and community contributions. Feel free to explore, contribute, or fork the repository!

Give it a try and let me know what you think!
Happy farming! 🌾🐓
